entries.note: The sender's data record: SPS has the label details, not yet the parcel. Its center is SPS's billing department, so it carries no location.
A courier collected the parcel from the sender. The former Webtrace tracker words it as Pickup.
The first scan in an SPS depot, usually right after the pickup. Webtrace words it as Initialization.
The parcel entered a depot. Webtrace words it as Entry.
The parcel is on the courier's delivery sheet for the day. Webtrace words it as Loaded for Delivery.
The parcel was placed in a parcel locker for the recipient to collect.
The website takes the delivery date from this code. Webtrace words it as Confirmation of Delivery.
The recipient refused the parcel. Webtrace words it as Refused.
The depot holds the parcel in storage; seen after a refusal and before the return to the sender.
The parcel goes back to its sender. Webtrace words it as Return to Shipper.
Information recorded with a delivery, minutes before it: not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage it had.
The depot books the cash collected on delivery: a payment step, not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage it had.
The cash on delivery was sent on to the sender, days after the delivery: a payment step, not a movement. Webtrace words it as COD sent to customer.
